glossy-3d: Glossy 3D icon illustration in a clean corporate style. Soft rounded shapes with a subtle plastic gloss, soft studio lighting and gentle contact shadows, seen from a three-quarter view. Main colours royal blue (#1F6FE5) and white, with small accents of green (#22A45D), yellow (#FFC233) and red (#E5484D). Each illustration groups two to four related objects into one compact scene that reads at a glance.
